messages:
maya: Heads up — the cost dashboard is showing a weird "gutter" of tokens for several routes this morning. per-route token cost spikes but cache savings are negative. :eyes:
kevin: Are these the routes with sticky routing + prefix cache enabled? we've seen ghost attribution there before.
aj: Yep. Sampling noise can turn amortized prefetched savings into negative numbers if the attribution window is too short. can you paste an example route id?
maya: route: ui-embed-legacy, spike at ~08:12 UTC. I dug into raw telemetry and we have ~12k tokens charged to that route while the global cache hit showed +9k; math is off.
sophia: Oh — could be double-counting when we replay deduped prefetched KV pairs during fallback. UX question: do we show raw per-invocation cost or an amortized estimate? users get confused when "savings" go below 0.
kevin: Internally we've debated this. two schools: show raw numbers w/ a big tooltip explaining sampling & attribution, or show a "smoothed amortized" line by default and let power users toggle raw. I prefer smoothing for the main dashboard.
maya: smoothing seems reasonable but we need a clear signal when there's an accounting bug vs expected variance. propose adding a "ghost token" badge when raw - smoothed > threshold.
aj: Implementation note: our attribution SQL is currently a left join on cache_fingerprint -> route. pseudocode: ```
SELECT r.route_id, SUM(inv.tokens) AS tokens_charged, SUM(cache.hits) AS cache_hits
FROM invocations inv
LEFT JOIN cache_events cache ON inv.prefetch_id = cache.prefetch_id
JOIN routes r ON inv.route_id = r.id
WHERE ts BETWEEN :start AND :end
GROUP BY r.route_id;
```
This will miss cases where prefetch_id is rewritten on fallback. need to join on fingerprint lineage instead.
sophia: For UX: show two small charts: smoothed amortized cost + toggle raw overlay. include "ghost token" list (top 3 suspicious invocations) with a quick link to the trace. that should defuse most tickets. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
kevin: Also propose a backend flag: cost_dashboard_v2 that opt-in exposes smoothed view + ghost detection. rollout to internal first.
billing-bot: [alert] route ui-embed-legacy exceeded expected token variance threshold (var=0.38) at 2026-03-21T08:13:05Z. See /observability/alerts/7234
maya: Action items: 1) aj to prototype lineage join and export sample of mismatched rows (deadline EOD) 2) kevin to add ghost-badge threshold config in feature flags (PR id?) 3) sophia to mock tiny-chart UX and tooltip text. I'll file a small playbook for support.
aj: On it — will attach a csv to the ticket.
kevin: I'll own the feature flag PR, will link when ready.
sophia: I'll drop a Figma frame and keep tooltips short: "Ghost tokens = tokens that look charged here but were likely prefetched elsewhere. hover for details."
maya: Thanks team. If we can get the prototype by EOD we can flip the flag for internal tomorrow. :thumbsup:
